result.one_liner: Social media platform for discovering, sharing, and shopping visual content

evidence.quote: Authorization Code is the most secure grant type because the user must explicitly approve the scopes requested by your app
Pinterest does not publish API access fees for either tier, so both Trial and Standard are effectively free
Trial applications are reviewed each business day
Pinterest API v5 is a REST API
To get started, create a business account and request Trial access to the Pinterest API at no charge

result.notes: Pinterest API uses OAuth2 with Authorization Code and Client Credentials flows. Trial tier is freely accessible via self-serve request (reviewed daily). Standard tier also free but requires app approval and video demo. No published pricing. REST API covering ads management, conversion tracking, analytics, and organic/paid content operations.
